in_marathi.name: Badal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rain, Cloud
in_marathi.long_meaning: Badal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Badal is the god of rain and clouds. He is also known as Indra, the king of gods. Badal's symbol is the thunderbolt, which he uses to bring rain and prosperity to the earth.
